title: Fixed effective machine coding
statement: Fix an effective machine coding: an encoding of coded Boolean Turing machines by Boolean words and a total decoding map such that every machine is recovered when its code is followed by any number of padding bits equal to $1$. The coding also includes a finite Boolean machine that computes the serialization of the machine decoded from any input word, together with a time bound for that computation.
